# Officially Fawnia

> Official site of Fawnia Mondey Dietrich — pole dance pioneer, fitness competitor, personal trainer, author, and the first person to produce instructional pole dancing videos.

Las Vegas-based. Founder of Pole Fitness Studio (Las Vegas's first pole dance studio). Decades of stage, print, and television work; certified personal trainer; creator of pole dance instructor certification.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Fawnia's story: pioneer of pole fitness since 1994
- [Résumé](/resume): Print, television, film and stage credits
- [Fitness](/fitness): Personal training and pole instructor certification
- [Blog](/blog): Fitness, nutrition and wellness articles
- [Gallery](/gallery): Bikini, competition, fitness, pole, fashion and published work
- [Videos](/videos): Instructional pole dance and fitness videos (PayPal checkout)
- [Contact](/contact): Bookings and inquiries
